note: Northampton County's zoning districts are published only as a PDF map (adopted April 2016) and a text ordinance; no queryable zoning layer found. County GIS host gis.northamptonnc.com was unreachable and its ArcGIS directory could not be probed; the county's mapping site (webapp.agdmaps.com/nc/northampton) is a viewer with no public service. Roanoke Rapids publishes its zoning map only as a PDF/web page; its only ArcGIS layer found (Roanoke_Rapids_Zoning2_(2), a parcel layer with a ZONE field, owner by a personal account) lies in the city, not covering the county point. Towns of Weldon, Jackson, Gaston publish PDF maps only.
